methods.name: UltraQuant (AMD, paper)
methods.code_status: kernel not released (paper); SGLang PR #41949 open (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41949); vLLM fork inside docker rocm/vllm-dev:quark-ultraquant-lmcache-mi355 (LMCache blog) [unverified that UltraQuant kernels are in that image]
methods.notes: arXiv 2606.20474; blog https://rocm.blogs.amd.com/software-tools-optimization/ultraquant-kv4/README.html. SGLang flags: --kv-cache-dtype ultraquant_4bit --attention-backend ultraquant. Rejects spec-decode, MLA, non-gfx950.

methods.name: uqmt (this repo)
methods.install_command: pip install -e ~/ultraquant-more (pyproject.toml, untracked at time of writing)
methods.entry_points_kv_quant_dequant: uqmt.attn.quantize_fp4 / dequantize_fp4 / fused K-query decode (see attn.py)

methods.name: kvpress (NVIDIA)
methods.install_command: pip install kvpress ; for 4-bit: pip install optimum-quanto
methods.entry_points_kv_quant_dequant: pipeline('kv-press-text-generation'); press(model) context manager; transformers QuantizedCache(backend='quanto', nbits=4)
methods.notes: Best harness for H2O/SnapKV/PyramidKV/StreamingLLM/ExpectedAttention etc on HF models; evaluation CLI in evaluation/ dir. Tested: Llama, Mistral, Phi3, Qwen2, Qwen3, Gemma3.

methods.name: BitDecoding-FP4 (2026)
methods.install_command: git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.git && cd BitDecoding-FP4 && bash tools/bootstrap_env.sh (needs CUDA>=13.0, driver>=580, Python 3.12, uv)
methods.entry_points_kv_quant_dequant: not documented on README page; vLLM out-of-tree CUSTOM attention backend
methods.notes: arXiv 2611.09825: native FP4 KV decode; abstract claims within 0.5 pt of BF16 (NVFP4), ~1 pt (MXFP4). Strong comparator for B300 results.

methods.name: STAR-KV (the 'StarKV' found; ICML 2026)
methods.install_command: git clone https://github.com/PriyanshBhatnagar/STAR-KV.git; conda create -n StarKV python=3.12.7; pip install -r requirements.txt
methods.entry_points_kv_quant_dequant: eval.py --kv-quant [--triton]; train.py (soft-threshold rank selection w/ distillation); kv_quant.py; latency.py
methods.notes: arXiv 2606.08382 (low-rank KV, NOT Star Attention). Triton 3.2-bit decode kernels MHA-only; GQA models only via fake-quant. Companion vLLM repo PriyanshBhatnagar/STAR-KV-Serve (HEAD a59aff9db42ff3adcc30c6002065511b45b9e862). Other 'STaR-KV' kawhiiiileo/STaR-KV (HEAD 35910334636b23ce2f7d4d3f79dc51dc334180b0) is GUI-VLM compression, arXiv 2606.01790, unrelated.

methods.name: SemKV (2026)
methods.bits: ~2.3-8 mixed (two adjacent precisions above a 'quality cliff' ~2.322 bits)
methods.code_status: NO public code found (arXiv abs/PDF/HTML/TeX only, searched twice)
methods.notes: arXiv 2608.28911 'SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff'. Keeps all tokens, ranks by model-internal score, mixed precision; 6.0x storage, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B. Not to be confused with SemanticKV arXiv 2611.11452 (video generation, eviction) or SeKV (arXiv 2606.31145; repo AmirAbaskohi/SeKV HEAD 6569d111d3ace5c7c1ad596bf36962a99cd7e94b, semantic-span offloading). Quality agent must reimplement from paper.
